name.value: Conrad Kain's Kitchen + Grill & Asia Nova Lounge

description.value: Conrad Kain's Kitchen + Grill is a full-service restaurant in Radium Hot Springs named after the legendary local mountaineer and alpine guide, featuring a small tribute described as a 'delicious museum.' Located next to Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort, the restaurant offers a wide-ranging menu of breakfasts, burgers, steaks, pastas, and pizzas using fresh and homemade ingredients. A seasonal outdoor patio overlooks the Columbia Valley, and the venue also hosts group events and corporate meetings.
